This Sailing Catamaran Is Built for Long-Range Ocean Voyages and Luxury Living
15 photos
Photo: JFA Yachts
French shipyard JFA Yachts has just announced the launch of a new sailing catamaran for bluewater cruising. Called the Long Island 87, the new multi-hull leisure vessel was developed for long-distance voyages, combining sailing performance with spacious living areas and the autonomy needed for extended cruising.
Over the last two decades, catamarans have seen a remarkable evolution, revolutionizing the maritime world with their unique designs that ensure a level of stability, comfort, and spaciousness you can not find in monohull vessels. While power catamarans have attracted owners looking for exhilarating speed and the freedom to explore far-flung destinations, sailing catamarans have found a devoted following among those seeking serene, unhurried journeys and a harmonious connection with the sea.
The Long Island 87 is a magnificent vessel that belongs to the latter category. Sold in October 2023, the 86-foot (26.2-meter) multihull was built for an owner who plans to travel the globe with their family and offers them a symphony of freedom, comfort, and reliability, with the right balance between performance under sail and functional living spaces.
The new catamaran is part of the shipyard’s Long Island range, which also includes the smaller Long Island 85 and the larger Long Island 100, and builds on the experience gained from these previous models in the series. According to JFA Yachts, the first two Long Island 85 cats have completed extensive voyages to remote destinations, including Antarctica and Greenland, as well as routes across the Pacific and the Baltic Sea.
Photo: JFA Yachts Developed as part of a 15-year collaboration between JFA Yachts and Marc Lombard Yacht Design Group, this new model preserves many of the proven design features seen on the previous models, while also introducing new ones. As such, it is built with an aluminum hull combined with a composite deck and superstructure, a construction that helps keep displacement low without compromising strength and performance.
According to the French shipyard, the vessel has about 30% less displacement than comparable models on the market, allowing for higher average speeds and lower fuel consumption.
The superstructure, however, features more modern lines, and one of the yacht’s defining features is the expansive flybridge. This elevated upper deck is fitted with not one but two helm stations and is configured as a full-fledged living space with a covered bar area and a spacious, inviting lounge with multiple seating options. It also benefits from panoramic views of the surrounding ocean, and its roof is covered with solar panels.
The Long Island 87 also introduces a new interior layout to the line. With a beam of 39 feet (11.8 meters), the vessel offers generous living quarters, with enough room for both private relaxation and socializing. There are 1,330 square feet (124 square meters) of living space, and the updated layout is designed to accommodate up to ten guests and four crew members.
Photo: JFA Yachts The owner’s suite stretches across the full width of the main deck . It offers 180-degree views of the sea and benefits from direct access to the foredeck. The port hull houses a children’s cabin with four berths and an aft guest cabin, while the starboard hull includes another guest cabin and the crew quarters.
The main deck is also home to a cockpit and the interior salon, with a lounge on the port side and a dining area to starboard. Thanks to large windows and a glass door, the convivial spaces flow seamlessly into the aft deck, extending the living spaces outdoors. Here, owners will be able to enjoy a sunbathing area and a swim platform that can also fit a 16-foot (4.9-meter) tender.
Photo: JFA Yachts The sailing catamaran ’s interiors will be completely bespoke to reflect the owners’ preferences and tastes. Darnet Design will bring their vision to life.
“We are very excited to launch this Long Island 87’ project,” says the future owner. “We found this yacht to be the perfect balance between performance under sail and functional living spaces. The Long Island 87’ is the optimal proven blue water sailing catamaran available in the market today and well suited for our specific mission, to circumnavigate the globe with our family of four in unparalleled comfort, safety, and luxury.”
